desc: 泵头量取、可叠加中等遮瑕、半脸妆效对照与色阶选色的底妆套图
name: 可调和中遮瑕裸感粉底液款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，用去盖露泵的正身白底图抢首图位
一秒把可叠加质地与妆效讲成核心利益，承接首图点击
放大普通底妆斑驳、卡纹、遮不住的日常挫败感
用一张脸的左右半对比证明中等遮瑕与裸感妆效
让不同肤色的买家把自己代入，建立拥有感
用一整片膏体微距证明延展度与细腻颗粒
用泵头与瓶壁结构特写解释可控取量这一机制
把多重妆效主张拆成四组同光同框对照，批量给证据
让买家在色阶矩阵里自行对号，降低选错色的顾虑
以空白印章与空数据位承接背书信息，消除风险又不编造
以 routine 组合陈列收口，抬客单并给出下一步动作位

style.backgroundSystem: seamless white #FFFFFF packshot field, pale studio paper #EFEBE5 for face-comparison and closing screens, sand-caramel liquid smear field #DDB483 for benefit screens, cool greige skin panel #D8D2CB and concrete grey board #C9C3BC for swatch and pain screens, warm taupe gradient #6E5F55 for portrait scenes, deep espresso #43291C bands and closing trust panel
style.iconSystem: single-weight thin-line icons and blank circular seal outlines in deep espresso #43291C only
style.lightingSystem: large front-left softbox key with a bounce fill, 5400K, soft contact shadows, controlled speculars on glass and pump collar, identical clamshell beauty light on every face panel, skimming low-incidence light only for texture macro
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent inclusive editorial base-makeup commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white studio field #FFFFFF, sand-caramel liquid texture field #DDB483, cool greige skin panel #D8D2CB and deep espresso graphic band #43291C with charcoal text #2B2320; neutral studio lighting from a large front-left softbox with bounce fill at 5400K, soft contact shadows and controlled speculars; modern geometric sans-serif; single-weight thin-line icons and empty pill and seal outline frames only; glossy liquid smear surfaces and brushed perspex used sparingly; stable slight 3/4 product angle and consistent product scale; identical light and crop across every comparison panel; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no model likeness drift, no invented badges or figures.
noDrift: no inconsistent lighting between comparison panels
no invented badges, percentages or test figures
style.presentationRules: the product keeps one slight 3/4 or straight-on angle and one consistent scale across the set; all faces are generic models lit and cropped identically and never tied to a source likeness; shade range is shown as graded strokes, never as codes
style.surfaceSystem: glossy liquid smear film #DDB483, brushed perspex sheet #EDEBE8 with a soft mirror reflection, matte greige board #C9C3BC
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; every headline band, pill label and seal is drawn as an empty outline frame so no wording is generated in-image
